After the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], the maverick [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] began a campaign against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who supported or allowed for the conflict to come to an end with the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Malgus's first target was the Sith [[Politics/Legends|politician]] Lord [[Adraas]], whom he '''hunted down''' sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Within [[Adraas's manse|Adraas's estate]], Malgus engaged his target and ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with his bare hands.
